integrity.provenance_note: Execution provenance uses the recorded runtime HEAD and frozen-file content hashes. The nine recorded files are checked against the explicit published commit; content equivalence does not mean the runtime checked out that commit.

recomputation.bootstrap: Independent weighted-order-statistic CVaR and paired seed-then-world percentile bootstrap; 1000 draws, RNG seed 7891.

test_input_hash_scope: These raw-input hashes were regenerated during independent review, not captured during the original run. World IDs, truth, scenario components and acquired neural encoder reports were checked against all corresponding original CSV rows.
review_type: Separate-agent post-run audit with independent statistics and raw-media/checkpoint replay; not independent-laboratory replication.

amendment_reason.new: Independent review of v1 found 11/4608 budget-7 static-baseline worlds fell back to an all-class uniform portfolio despite acquired zero-weight reports being present. Fix this support-constraint bug, preserve v1 evidence, and use new heldout worlds. No change to endpoint, risk grid, budgets, training, calibration, validation or success criteria.

validity_assessment.conclusion: The amended implementation is auditable and its previous static-support exception is closed, but the fresh heldout experiment does not meet the registered tail-risk efficacy criteria. The point estimate is smaller than 0.02 and its 95% paired bootstrap interval crosses zero. Preserve the original positive v1 result and this negative fresh-holdout result separately; neither pooling nor selecting the favorable run is warranted. Dedicated-cloud execution is still unverified.

primary.interpretation: The registered efficacy result is not confirmed. A tail-loss improvement remains possible, but neither the required point magnitude nor an interval wholly below zero was obtained. The quality gate is a point-estimate margin, not a statistical noninferiority finding.

incremental_ndu_preference.reason: The tail-loss interval reaches zero, while mean loss and quality are worse in point estimates.

recursion.budget7_scope: Different recursive decisions exist at the larger budget, but these secondary observations cannot replace the failed registered primary endpoint.

joint_error_model.interpretation: The full joint model is correctly distinct from its conditional-independence ablation, but the fresh-holdout tail-loss contrast also crosses zero.

secondary_positive_contrasts.scope: These exploratory contrasts are retained; they do not rescue the failed prespecified comparison against the validation-selected static portfolio or establish NDU-specific novelty.

shift_failure.interpretation: All methods fail under the changed common-error coalition at the primary budget; calibrated trust is not robust to this distribution shift.

common_bias_failure.interpretation: Mutually consistent raw outputs remain wrong under common-mode sensor bias.

resolved_prior_issue.original_scope: v1 IID budget7 static baseline, 4608 worlds
resolved_prior_issue.amended_rule: When all positive-weight reports are missing, use remaining acquired reports before considering uniform; uniform is allowed only when no acquired report exists.
resolved_prior_issue.description: Only the support fallback and heldout namespace changed in executed logic. Budget7 static validation choices changed under the amended rule. Budget4 selected policies, endpoints, grids, training and calibration remained unchanged.

limitations: Both rounds reuse exactly the same three training seeds and learned weights. They do not constitute six independent training seeds; the two holdout sets were not pooled in this review.
Three seeds limit inference about training variability. 169344 rows are repeated arm/budget evaluations of 8064 distinct worlds; primary inference uses 4608 worlds across three seeds.
The fresh-holdout primary interval includes meaningful improvements and small degradations. Failure to meet the endpoint does not establish that every beneficial effect is absent.
The quality margin uses nearest-prototype correctness. NDU increases ambiguity and reduces resolved-correct fraction; risk reduction cannot be presented as a general improvement in semantic quality.

All eight class concepts are shared between training and evaluation, and the generator is deliberately supervised to decode convex mixtures of canonical media. This does not establish natural language, speech, image or video generalization.

The controller is a finite hand-specified forward-preference entropic DP, not a continuous Merton solution, neural FBSDE, native Hepta implementation, diffusion language model or joint NDU generator training.
The cost condition uses dense Linear MAC formulas for actual chosen paths, not total hardware FLOPs, energy or end-to-end cost. Offline costs are reported separately.
Raw heldout inputs were regenerated for this audit from frozen seeds and code; their review-time hashes are explicitly distinguished from hashes captured during the original run.

The runtime worktree HEAD remains the recorded base. Its actual nine-file content manifest matches the published amendment commit f44540ab59a0a8f013437ccbe8579db607fac03e; this does not mean the runtime checkout HEAD was that commit.
The dedicated cloud gate remains unverified. Even a later infrastructure success would not turn the current negative local efficacy result into a positive result.
No global efficient frontier, recursive benefit at budget4, NDU preference superiority, or robust common-bias mitigation is established by this run.
